resources.string: AwayDoomscrollin\' examines accessibility text and labels, view identifiers, window changes, taps and scroll events on your device to recognize protected feeds and short videos in Instagram, TikTok and YouTube. It can show curtains in Instagram and YouTube and perform specific, rule-based Back, tap and scroll actions on protected screens. Screen information is processed only on your device, never saved or sent to a server. Optional usage-data sharing is a separate choice. Changes to other apps\' interfaces can affect detection.
